kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ادلهممت (form IVq)
# اِدْلَهْمَمْتُ (idlahmamtu) /id.lah.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# اِدْلَهْمَمْتَ (idlahmamta) /id.lah.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# اِدْلَهْمَمْتِ (idlahmamti) /id.lah.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
